editorial:
Imagine you are totally excited for your grandpa to move in, but then he takes over your bedroom and kicks you up to a creepy attic. That is exactly what happens to Peter, and it kicks off a hilarious battle of wits. You get to watch a kid and an old man use everything from fake bugs to loud noises to try and prank each other out of the room. The whole vibe is light, silly, and feels like a giant game of tag where the stakes are just a comfortable bed. It is the kind of movie that does not take itself too seriously and just wants to make you laugh.

What really makes this work is the chemistry between the leads, as they both play their roles with a lot of energy. The pacing is quick, so you never feel bored, though some of the jokes are a bit predictable. If you have kids or just want something easy to watch on a Friday night, you will love this. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for a crisp look, or if you prefer renting on Apple TV, that works too. For those who love owning their movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great way to keep the laughs handy.
endingExplained: After a series of wild pranks, Peter and his grandpa realize they both just want to feel loved and respected. They stop fighting and decide to share the space and their friendship. The war ends with a heartfelt apology and a hug. In the end, they find a way to coexist peacefully in the house, proving that family is more important than who gets the bigger bedroom.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves goofy family comedies and lighthearted pranks.
